Experimental_Design.Conditions: ERP study based on Exp3a design but sequential presentation; 6 conditions (good-self, neutral-self, bad-self, good-other, neutral-other, bad-other); 2 (matching) x 2 (reference) x 3 (moral character), within-subject

Block_Structure.Trial_number: Day1: 1080 (9 x 120); Day2: 1620 (18 x 90) + 0-1620 extra per subject

Stimulus_Properties.Modality: Visual perceptual matching task (EEG recorded day 2)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: 3.6° x 1.6°

exp6b.detail: ERP study (explicit self-referencing, sequential presentation). Two days: day 1 = practice/behavioral run (Session 1), day 2 = EEG recording (Session 2/3; raw d2 file Session field kept verbatim - subject 6205/6223 day-2 data labeled Session 3, 6 subjects have extra Session-3 runs). Paper analyzes day-1 behavior only (Table 1 N=23 (22)); DB includes d1+d2 per user decision. extraIV1 = SHAPE-side moral valence (from Shape text; author codes from label-side morality column). Label = label .bmp file name; label identity = raw identity column (1:1 with file name). No-response -> ACC=NA/RT_ms=NA. One fully-empty artifact row (subject 6205 session 2) dropped from Clean (kept in raw).
